title: Design System: lore
northStar: The instrument panel that shows its own confidence — dense, dark, one accent, and never a figure it cannot support.

ground._rule: The ramp runs both ways: inset recedes, raised lifts. A recessed panel steps down the ramp rather than mixing black into its parent.

category._rule: Three forms per hue: solid for legend swatches, fill for chip backgrounds and lane bars, tint for text on that fill. Defined once as tokens; components never restate the literal.

material.vibrancy: macOS underWindowBackground, followsWindowActiveState, radius 10 — applied at the window and revealed only by the scope rail, which paints rgba(255,255,255,0.022) of its own
material.rule: Dense content never sits on a live background. A raised surface changes its shadow, not only its border.

tokens.bar-grow: 620ms, scaleX from 0.02, transform-origin left, staggered 22ms per lane up to 12
tokens.state-change: 120ms ease-out on background and color for rows and toggles

motion.rule: One authored moment per surface, from an already-visible default. All motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

typeFloor.rule: No micro-labels. Small type in a light weight is the combination this system rules out; the floor exists so a future surface cannot reintroduce it.

numerics.face: ui-monospace, SF Mono, JetBrains Mono, Menlo, monospace
rules: A span under one minute prints <1m, never 0m — a block holding a single record still happened.
A range crossing midnight prints its dates; clock times alone contradict a multi-day span.
A count the data can only floor is labelled as a floor, never as a total.

confidence.purpose: The signature device: attribution carries the evidence that produced it.

witnessed.meaning: the transcript records the assistant running the commit

files-match.meaning: inferred — the commit's files were written in this session

inferred.meaning: timing and project only; likely committed by hand

unattributed.meaning: no session to attribute this to

iconSystem.rule: One drawn set. No glyph, emoji or text character stands in for an icon. Two icons encode certainty rather than objects: a closed ring for witnessed, the same ring broken for inferred.

componentSnippets.selection: .row.on { background: rgba(233,61,151,0.16); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(233,61,151,0.42); color: #edeef2; }
componentSnippets.honesty-flag: .flag.amber { color: #f2a93b; background: rgba(242,169,59,0.14); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 540; }
componentSnippets.scrollbar: ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border: 3px solid transparent; background-clip: content-box; border-radius: 8px; }
componentSnippets.digest-metric: .digest > span { white-space: nowrap; } /* atomic, so a wrap lands between metrics and never inside a phrase */
componentSnippets.moment-spine: .spine::before { position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--line-strong); } .mark { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-dim); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--surface); }

timeAsStructure.rule: Where records carry a time, time structures the layout — it is never merely a column of labels. A run of file changes is grouped into moments (saves within one minute) hung off a continuous spine, and an idle stretch past five minutes prints its own duration, because the pause is part of the record.
appliesTo: file-change lists in the detail pane and the stream
timeAsStructure.counterExample: A flat table with a time column reads as a list, not a timeline; that was the first attempt and it was wrong.

dos: Show how a claim was established, next to the claim.
Keep magenta for selection and live state; keep amber for uncertainty.
Set data in the mono token with tabular numerals.
Name what a surface does hold when it cannot show what was expected.
Give a raised surface a shadow with offset and blur.
donts: Set type below 13px or below weight 500.
Use the accent as a glow, a gradient, or a decorative fill.
Extend vibrancy beyond the scope rail, or add blur for atmosphere.
Render a calendar grid or a contribution heatmap as a primary view.
Print a figure the data cannot support.
Introduce a second accent, or let a category hue carry state.
notCanonized: The residual empty space below the lanes at short ranges. Lane rows and bars were enlarged to fill more of the stage, but a sparse week still leaves roughly a third of the view empty. That is a layout shortfall the build carries, not a rule for future surfaces to inherit.
